notes.title: Achievements Unlocked for Assassin's Creed III Remastered!
notes.content:
[h2][h3]🔓 Achievements Unlocked! 🔓[/h3][/h2]

It’s time to dive back into the 1775 American Colonies as Steam Achievements are now available for Assassin’s Creed III Remastered, including the Tyranny of King Washington DLC and Assassin's Creed Liberation.

Complete challenges and unlock achievements as you journey through Connor’s epic story. Whether you're a completionist or casually exploring the frontier, there's something for everyone to aim for!
 
[b]Do Achievements Sync Automatically?[/b]
Achievements will be retroactively earned for those accomplishments already completed in your journey, simply launch the game once on Steam, and your progress will sync automatically.

[b]What About Assassin's Creed III?[/b]
Achievements for Assassin's Creed III have also been released.
